content.title: Pest Control Strategies
content.body:
This note outlines the task of developing a pest management plan for the vegetable garden.

## Task Details
- **Content**: Investigate pest control options, focusing on fencing for rabbits and natural deterrents instead of chemicals.
- **Goal**: Develop a pest management plan for the vegetable garden.
- **Deadline**: 2023-04-15
- **Notes**: Prioritize eco-friendly solutions to maintain a sustainable garden environment. Research local pests like rabbits.
